summary: The main article describes a photoredox Nozaki-Hiyama reaction using air-stable Cr(III) salts and organic TADF photocatalysts. It includes optimization tables for reaction conditions, a scope scheme for aliphatic aldehydes and substituted allylbromides, and a mechanistic proposal supported by photophysical studies.
